projectDescription: A VS Code extension that supercharges NestJS development with smart logger insertion and instant module file navigation.
keyFeatures: Smart NestJS Logger insertion (debug, log, warn, error, verbose) with automatic class name detection
Intelligent insertion point detection — places logger after closing braces, not inside code blocks
Module File Searcher — instantly navigate all files within a NestJS module using shortcut letters
Browse All Modules picker — list every *.module.ts in the workspace and jump into its files
Files grouped by category: Core NestJS, Entities, DTOs, Enums, Interfaces, Other
Keyboard chord shortcuts for all commands (Cmd+L / Ctrl+L prefix)
18 recognized NestJS file types with emoji labels and instant shortcut navigation
publicApiSurface: nestjs-log-helper.insertDebugLog — Insert this.logger.debug() with class context
nestjs-log-helper.insertLogLog — Insert this.logger.log() with class context
nestjs-log-helper.insertWarnLog — Insert this.logger.warn() with class context
nestjs-log-helper.insertErrorLog — Insert this.logger.error() with class context
nestjs-log-helper.insertVerboseLog — Insert this.logger.verbose() with class context
nestjs-log-helper.moduleSearcher — Browse all modules in workspace and navigate files
nestjs-log-helper.searchModuleFiles — Search files in the current file's module
findAllModuleFiles(moduleRoot) — Discovers and categorises all .ts files in a module directory
getEnclosingClassName(document, line) — Walks up from cursor to find the enclosing class name
